name: Ironclad Agrisystems Synthetic Protein Fabrication
description: An industrial bioreactor system that produces synthetic protein substrates — meat, dairy, and egg analogs — from cellular agriculture processes without requiring animal husbandry. The SPF system cultures animal cells in a nutrient medium, growing muscle tissue, fat, and connective tissue in controlled conditions to produce food products biochemically identical to their animal-sourced equivalents. Ironclad operates SPF facilities alongside their Mega-Farms, producing the protein component of GLMZ's food supply. The technology has made animal agriculture obsolete within the city.
base_technologies: Animal cell culture at industrial scale
enables: Scalable protein supply independent of agriculture
social_impact: SPF has eliminated the ethical concerns of animal agriculture while creating new ones about the industrialization of life. The protein products are indistinguishable from animal-sourced equivalents in taste, texture, and nutrition, and most of GLMZ's population consumes them daily without knowing or caring about the distinction. A small but vocal movement insists on 'natural' animal products, which are available as luxury items at prices that make them status symbols.
story_hooks: An SPF facility has been found producing biological tissue that does not match any food product specification — the bioreactors are growing something that is not food, and the output is being shipped to an unlisted destination.

Ironclad's synthetic protein has been found to contain trace compounds that act as mild appetite suppressants in lower-tier formulations — the population is being subtly medicated through their food supply.
